sourceMaterials.use: Held is Helpless, magically immobilized, cannot perform physical actions but can perform purely mental ones.
3.0 Held example: creature remains aware, breathes, cannot speak, and can perform purely mental actions.
Pinned is immobile in grapple but not Helpless; Held occurs descriptively as a Helpless example.
Pin, escape, speech suppression, attacker-relative -4 AC, and grapple persistence.
Effect now explicitly uses Paralyzed instead of a distinct Held condition.

decisions.mechanics: Helpless, speed 0, no speech or physical actions, purely mental actions preserved; no automatic Incapacitated/Concentration break.
decisions.originMapping: 3.0 Held; 3.5 Hold Person explicitly applies Paralyzed instead.

decisions.mechanics: Applies Grappled but not Helpless, pinning-creature-relative -4 AC, optional speech suppression, one-round source duration, separate escape options.
Keep source identity of grappler and pinner, distinguish break-pin from escape-grapple, keep Touch/Flat-Footed separate axes.
3.5 opposed grapple check in place of attack, alternative Escape Artist using Standard Action; unify with BAB and Action economy later.
3.5 component limits and concentration skill check DC 20 + spell level; not yet substituted for 5.x Concentration save.

sourceRights: 3.x sources are historical Open Game Content under OGL, kept separate from the pinned CC BY SRD 5.x pack; no verbatim historical text has been added.
